audit.why: Packet flags 'Seraphine wins 58.51% but chart gives Caitlyn 6/7 stages' as a contradiction, but the other two matchups in this slice show the same pattern (aphelios winRate 57.52 with a late-game shift to Aphelios, ashe winRate 54.8 with a flat chart) suggesting the winRate field tracks the ENEMY's win rate, not Seraphine's — under that reading a high winRate paired with Caitlyn dominating most stages is consistent, not contradictory. I cannot confirm which convention is correct from the kit alone, so per the chart rule I left phases[].side/win[] untouched rather than guess.
Spikes correctly identify Caitlyn's range/Headshot dominance through 1st item and the late-game flip once she's reachable in teamfights, matching a lane-bully-into-even-late curve.

audit.whatIsWrong: Caitlyn misgendered as 'he/his' in winCon, report[1].t, and report[9].t. breakdown.cooldowns names Yordle Snap Trap as matchup-defining but has no cooldown number, and omits the missing interaction that Caitlyn's Ace in the Hole (R) is a channel Seraphine's E or R can cancel outright. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js/lintFindings confirm Caitlyn is she/her. missingInteractions flags the channel-interrupt fact as applicable but absent from the text. Real cooldowns: W 0.5s, R 90s.
audit.corrected: Fixed the three pronoun instances, folded the channel-interrupt fact plus real cooldown numbers into breakdown.cooldowns, and rewrote the two copy-paste-bleed bodies to match their titles.

edits.before: - Caitlyn Yordle Snap Traps: matchup-defining — The trap under your feet starts the headshot chain — never fight standing on one. It governs your forward steps. - E Beat Drop spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: Caitlyn's Yordle Snap Trap (W) is a 0.5s-cd chain-starter — never fight standing on one. Her Ace in the Hole (R, 90s cd) is a channel: your E or R cancels it outright if she tries to snipe first. Hold your own R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: W shields, and only heals once you're already shielded — land both casts every exchange so the free sustain, not raw damage, wins the extended trade.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Caitlyn's headshot range and net-trap combo reach your position before your support's — stay behind their body and peel, don't soak range you don't have.
